Text-to-SQL is a critical semantic parsing task that converts natural language queries into corresponding SQL statements based on a given database schema. While generative language models have demonstrated significant potential in single-turn Text-to-SQL tasks, their performance diminishes in multi-turn scenarios.

To evaluate the performance of our method in the text-to-SQL task, we adopted two official metrics: Question Match (QM) and Interaction Match (IM), along with three widely recognized sub-metrics: Exact Match Accuracy (EM), Execution Accuracy (EX), and Test Suite Accuracy (TS).
